advisories.whyNotAFinding: Advisories are not an ACCEPT bar, the artifact discloses rather than drops them, and none bears on either claimed repair. Filing this as SHOULD-FIX would deny acceptance over an accumulation the artifact is being transparent about.
advisories.suggestion: A later successor should either fold them or record once why the class is being carried indefinitely, so 'not folded this successor' stops being the standing answer by default. This is the same drift I have flagged elsewhere in this corpus; noting it for consistency, not as a bar here.

whatIsSoundInV7: The repair breaks a pattern the v6 verdict named explicitly - that three successive rounds of record-keeping repair had each introduced a new record-keeping defect. v7 adds without deleting, fixes the class rather than the two instances, and installs a reviewGuidance guard so the next reviewer is told to run the same attack.

The LIVE standing on reMeasurementAtV7 is the right discipline: it distinguishes the one current claim from the per-generation historical snapshots, so no reader can mistake an authoring pin for a live one.
